name: Mystic Coin
description:
Coins are used to create high-level weapons at the Mystic Forge in Lion's Arch. 
Part of Zommoros's favorite trades.

name: Pact Victory Token
description: Quartermaster Hargrove offers good service rewards in exchange for this symbol of victory.

name: Tournament Ticket
description: Used for tournaments which require an entry fee.

name: Black Lion Chest Key
description:
This key will unlock one Black Lion Chest containing random Gem Store merchandise, including some rare items not sold separately.

Black Lion Chests can be found randomly on enemies or bought from the trading post.

name: Mystic Forge Stone
description: Take this stone to the Mystic Forge to have Zommoros forge something special for you.

name: Bank Access Express
description: Double-click to access your account bank from anywhere. Single use.

name: Black Lion Salvage Kit
description: Double-click, then select an item in your inventory to salvage for crafting materials. 100% chance of recovering upgrades (excluding infusions). 50% chance to get rarer materials.

name: Limited-Use Cow Finisher
description: Crush your opponents with this falling cow finishing move in PvP and WvW.

name: Instant Armor-Reinforcing Canister
description: Double-click to instantly reinforce armor.

name: Bag Slot Expansion
description: Add an extra bag slot to a character's inventory. The slot comes equipped with a basic bag. Each character can unlock up to 10 additional bag slots.

name: Bank Tab Expansion
description:
Double-click to add an extra bank tab to your account.
Each account can have up to 18 total bank tabs.

name: Revive Orb
description:
Rally from defeat at your current location.

This item cannot be used in raids, PvP, or WvW.

details.name: Revive Sickness
details.description: You remain in combat until sickness wears off.

name: Experience Booster
description: Double-click to gain an enhancement that grants an additional 50% experience from kills for one hour.

name: Dye Pack
description:
Each dye box contains 7 random dyes (5 common and 2 uncommon or rare). 

Dyes can be unlocked for unlimited use to color armor on all characters. Dye bottles can also be recycled in the Mystic Forge.

<c=#FFC957>All common dyes have an equal chance to drop.

Rare or uncommon dye chances:
• Rare: ~20%
• Uncommon: ~80%</c>

name: Killstreak Experience Booster
description: Boost lasts for one hour. Kill streaks last 60 seconds from the most recent kill and can be restarted as often as necessary within the hour.

details.name: Active Kill Streak!
details.description: +10% exp from kills for each stack. Maximum: +100%

name: Box o' Fun
description: Double-click to create a box full of random goofs and gags! Lasts 15 minutes.

name: Karma Booster
description: Double-click to gain an enhancement that increases karma gained by 50% for one hour. Does not affect karma gained from consumable items.

name: Experience Booster
description:
Grants the following benefits for 2 hours:
• +50% Experience in All Game Types
• +50% Reward Track Gain in PvP and WvW
• Up to 100% Bonus Experience for Kill Streaks

name: Item Booster
description:
Grants the following benefits for 2 hours:
• +50% Magic Find
• +50% Chance of Critical Crafting Experience Gain
• +33% Chance of Extra Gathering Strike
• 10 seconds of Swiftness after Gathering
• Summons a Black Lion Merchant If Your Inventory Is Full after Gathering (20-Minute Cooldown)

name: Caithe's Bloom Dagger Skin
description: Double-click to apply this look to any other dagger.

name: Heroic Booster
description:
Grants both Experience Booster and Item Booster benefits for 2 hours, including:
• +50% Experience in All Game Types
• +50% Reward Track Gain in PvP and WvW
• Up to 100% Bonus Experience for Kill Streaks
• +50% Magic Find
• +50% Chance of Critical Crafting Experience Gain
• +33% Chance of Extra Gathering Strike
• 10 Seconds of Swiftness after Gathering 
• Summons a Black Lion Merchant If Your Inventory Is Full after Gathering (20-Minute Cooldown)

name: Magic Find Booster
description: Double-click to gain an enhancement that gives an additional 50% Magic Find for one hour.

name: Crafting Booster
description: Double-click to gain an enhancement that increases your chance to gain bonus experience from crafting by 50% for one hour.

name: Rejuvenation Booster
description: Double-click to gain a boon that regenerates health for one hour. Does not work in PvP, WvW, or raids.

name: Strength Booster
description: Double-click to gain a boon that increases your outgoing damage by 5% for one hour. Does not work in PvP, WvW, or raids.

name: Speed Booster
description: Double-click to gain a boon that increases your speed by 15% for one hour. Does not work in PvP, WvW, or raids.

name: Armor Booster
description: Double-click to gain a boon that reduces incoming damage by 5% for one hour. Does not work in PvP, WvW, or raids.

name: Trading Post Express
description: Double-click to summon a Black Lion Delivery Agent for 15 minutes, allowing you and your allies to pick up trading post purchases and profits. Single-use.

name: Merchant Express
description: Double-click to summon a Black Lion Merchant for 15 minutes, allowing you and your allies to access basic supplies and sell loot. Single-use.

name: Minis 3-Pack (Set 1)
description: Double-click to receive 3 randomly selected Minis (2 common and 1 uncommon) to add to your collection.

name: Booster Multipack
description: Contains boosts to increase karma gained, experience gained by killing enemies, and chance to find magic items. Each lasts one hour. Use all three at once, or each one individually!

name: Hall of Monuments Portal Stone
description: Double-click to travel to the ruins of the Hall of Monuments.

description:
This full set of heavy armor skins can replace the appearance of heavy armor pieces, once per slot. The skins will also be unlocked in your account wardrobe.

Skins have no stats of their own.
Can only be used by characters who wear heavy armor.

description:

Skins have no stats of their own.
Can only be used by characters who wear medium armor.

buff.description:
Gain a charge of +10 healing each time you kill a foe, five charges if you kill an enemy player. (Max 25 stacks; ends on down.)
(Only one attribute-stacking sigil can be active at a time.)

Inflict bleeding for 6 seconds upon critically hitting a foe.
(Cooldown: 2 Seconds)

On Hit: Inflict Vulnerability (10 seconds)
(Cooldown: 2 seconds)
Your next three attacks after swapping to this weapon while in combat have a 100% critical chance. <c=@reminder>(Cooldown: 9 Seconds)</c>

Your next attack after you swap to this weapon while in combat inflicts poison for 5 seconds.
(Cooldown: 9 seconds)
Gain 25% of your endurance when you swap to this weapon while in combat. <c=@reminder>(Cooldown: 9 Seconds)</c>
Gain 4 stacks of might (5 seconds) when you swap to this weapon while in combat. <c=@reminder>(Cooldown: 9 seconds)</c>

name: Arrow Cart Blueprints
description: Use to construct an arrow cart build site. The arrow cart's primary function is to deal moderate area damage to infantry. Range 2,500. Requires 25 supply to complete.

name: Ballista Blueprints
description: Use to construct a ballista build site. The ballista's primary function is to deal heavy single target damage to siege equipment and infantry. Range 3,000. Requires 30 supply to complete.

name: Catapult Blueprints
description: Use to construct a catapult build site. The catapult's primary function is to deal heavy area damage to walls or moderate damage to gates. Range 4,000. Requires 40 supply to complete.

name: Alpha Siege Golem Blueprints

name: Trebuchet Blueprints
description: Use to construct a trebuchet build site. The trebuchet's primary function is to deal heavy area damage to walls or moderate damage to gates. Range 10,000. Requires 50 supply to complete.

name: Flame Ram Blueprints
description: Use to construct a flame ram build site. The flame ram's primary function is to deal heavy damage to gates. Unable to damage walls. Range 360. Requires 40 supply to complete.

name: Adept's Training Manual
description: Double-click to use. This item will unlock the ability to spend up to 10 points in all trait lines, and will refund your currently spent trait points. This item can only be used once.

name: Master's Training Manual
description: Double-click to use. This item will unlock the ability to spend up to 20 points in all trait lines, and will refund your currently spent trait points. This item can only be used once.

name: Grandmaster's Training Manual
description: Double-click to use. This item will unlock the ability to spend up to 30 points in all trait lines, and will refund your currently spent trait points. This item can only be used once.

name: Commander's Compendium
description: Double-click to use. Unlock the ability to become a Commander.

name: Ert's Unguent
description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
The stench of this is almost unbearable. One gulp and you'll understand why Ert is so green and angry all the time.

name: Cuatl Tonic
description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
There's a faint whiff of flies and swamp water. Drink enough of this and you'll turn red, too.

name: Cold Filtered Wurm Tincture
description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
Made high in the Shiverpeak Mountains using a secret wurm-bladder filtration process...it's not for everyone.

name: Raven Tonic
description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
A spiced, smoky concoction. Raven shamans make this, but nobody knows where or how.

name: Morgan's Orchid
description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
Morganas orchidae. This rare blossom is as beautiful as it is hardy. No one knows what gives it such resilience.

name: Toxal Bog Stew
description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
Brewed from mystery ingredients found in the Toxal Bog—equal parts hearty meal and bug repellent.

name: Tasty Meat
description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
The finest cut of meat at Meatoberfest. The smell of its flame-roasted goodness makes it impossible to resist.

name: Draithor's Lab's Powerfully Weird Meat
description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
This...food has an unfamiliar but tempting aroma. Probably best to eat it first and not ask questions.

name: Prototype Ooze Concentrate Tincture
description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
There's a faint whiff of something strange and powerfully concentrated. Drink this at your own risk.

name: Unidentified Beverage
description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
A bottle of liquid found near a fallen explorer in Orr. The origin of the beverage is unknown.

name: Sunken Rations
description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
These drowned rations are sodden with seawater.

name: Grawl Paint
description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
This clay is obviously magical. No wonder the grawl spread it all over the place. You should be able to imbue yourself with its essence.

name: Choya Stew
description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
It's unclear what's in this concoction, but just smelling it makes your nose twitch.

name: Spider Egg
description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
The spiders here grow very large. It stands to reason that their eggs must make you stronger...

name: Centaur Feed
description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
This is the feed from the local centaur tribe. It's mostly berries and grass, but you can smell some mystery ingredient... Must be good.

name: Bottle of Skrittsburgh Special
description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
A thick, hearty beverage favored in Skrittsburgh. It seems to contain some kind of grain along with trace tufts of fur.

name: Mysterious Meat
description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
This strange fermented meat smells exotic. Maybe it's best not to think about where it came from.

name: Mini-moa Egg
description: Double-click to use. Hatch out a Mini-moa to dance for you.

name: Iron Harvesting Sickle
description: Used to gather Taproots, Spinach, Strawberries, Herb Sprouts, and all other lesser edible plants. Can also crack open Clams.

name: Iron Logging Axe
description: Used to chop down Gummo Saplings, Mimosa Saplings, Snow Cherry Saplings, and all other lesser saplings.

name: Iron Mining Pick
description: Used to mine Iron Ore, Silver Ore, and all other lesser metals.

name: Orichalcum Logging Axe
description: Used to chop down all saplings.

name: Orichalcum Mining Pick

name: Darksteel Mining Pick

name: Mithril Harvesting Sickle

name: Bun Yan Axe

"Sneaking up on someone is easy. Keeping others from noticing you is the hard part."
—Morina

—Morina

"Amazingly well preserved."

description:
"If only we had a way to fire them back."

description:
"They won't be using these on us anytime soon."

description:
"This is the smallest trident I've ever seen."
—Hua'racche

description:

—Hua'racche

description:
"Looks like the bandits, Inquest, and Nightmare Court are working together?"
—Mathair

name: Trade Agreement
description:
"Pretty detailed trade agreement for a bunch of bandits. The Inquest must have written it."
—Mathair

description:
"Looks really old. I wonder where it came from."
—Rhea

description:
"Do you think it might be older than the dragons?"
—Rhea

description:
"Nothing can stand against our combined power."

description:
"Between the three of us, there's nothing we can't handle."

—Issa

description:
"I feel like I've seen these markings somewhere before."

description:
"Usually only nobles wear these, but I just found a ton of 'em."
—Mrr'kkant

description:
"If anyone asks, you didn't get it from me."
—Mrr'kkant

description:
"So shiny! You want it, yes? You won't find shinier!"
—Mrr'kkant

description: The egg of a grub. The Tarstar tribe is known to eat this particular delicacy.

name: Heart of Fire
description: The smoldering heart of an elder imp of fire.

name: Burning Ember
description: Holding this mass feels like your hand is on fire.

name: Heart of Darkness
description: The corrupting heart of an elder imp of shadow.

name: Volcanic Earth Elemental Core
description: The core of a volcano-dwelling earth elemental. Ambr's lab wants these for their golem experiments. It looks like three cores will power an inactive golem.

description: The Order of Whispers can use this key to hamper Inquest efforts in this area.

description: The Order of Whispers can use this key to hamper Inquest efforts in this area.

name: Grawl Potion
description: Hunter Glynis may find this useful.

description:
This gruesome limb once belonged to one of Zhaitan's undead minions. The asura harvesting team can use this body part for experiments.
Event Item

name: Breeze Rider Essence

name: Encryption Crystal
description: This crystal contains information that will help Frazz gain control of Bauxite Alchemicals faster.

name: Orrian Energy Source
description: This energy source could be the key to something...

name: Harpy Feather
description: A feather plucked from a harpy. Wode might find these useful.

name: Jotun Runestone
description: Albin Chronicler is very interested in these.

name: Blue Wurm Husk
description:
An odd blue wurm husk
<c=@flavor>"This may have come from a Bug!"</c>

name: Cursed Pirate Artifact
description: Priory explorers have been searching for these.

name: Jellyfish Remains
description: A real quaggan treat!

name: Crabmeat

name: Meat Hunk

name: Firefly Essence
description: The hylek have been known to concoct powerful explosives by processing remains of luminescent insects.

name: Slice of Grub Meat

name: Undamaged Power-Bauble

name: Red Summoning Stone

name: Blue Summoning Stone

name: Black Summoning Stone

name: Volcanic Rock
description: A shard of pitch black volcanic rock. It is extremely sharp. Sangdo Swiftwing is interested in these.

name: Scrap Metal
description: Oddly marked scrap metal taken from the steam creatures.

name: Explosive Powder
description: A special explosive that destroys steam creatures. Remember, don't use too much.

name: Skritt Artifact

name: Preserved Red Iris Flower
description: <c=@flavor>Lovingly preserved specimen of an exceedingly rare iris.</c>

name: Kurzick Bauble
description: <c=@flavor>Smuggled out of Cantha long ago, a relic of the Great House of Lutgardis.</c>

name: Warmaster's Family Heirloom
description: <c=@flavor>Generations of norn-etched runes cover this dolyak horn. The most recent is a symbol of the Vigil.</c>

name: Totem of the Gorilla
description: <c=@flavor>An intrepid norn artist paid respect to a far-flung Spirit of the Wild with this carving.</c>

name: Fledgling Charm
description: <c=@flavor>Young tengu are given charms like this for protection.</c>

name: Anton's Secret
description: <c=@flavor>An item to be hidden in the most unlikely of places.</c>

name: Passiflora Karkinata
description: <c=@flavor>An extremely rare and powerful floral specimen.</c>

name: Ancient Karka Carapace
description: <c=@flavor>Part of the ancient karka that attacked Lion's Arch. Mysterious magics seem to be woven into its chitinous shell.</c>

name: Molten Ore
description: <c=@flavor>A dark artifact of the combined forces of the Flame Legion and dredge. This ore seems too impure to properly refine, but it gleams with dark potential.</c>

name: Big Mama's Tooth
description: <c=@flavor>Legends speak of "Big Mama," the largest drake broodmother that ever lived. If she still does, it seems she's short at least one tooth.</c>

name: Amulet of Protection
description: <c=@flavor>Stolen from the body of a long-forgotten lord during the Guild Wars.</c>

name: Salma's Diamond Jubilee Necklace
description: <c=@flavor>Queen Salma's reign was long and prosperous. Such prosperity has long been missed in Kryta.<c>

name: Kodan Prayer Beads
description: <c=@flavor>A string of 49 ivory beads.</c>

name: Amulet of the Skies
description: <c=@flavor>A talented Durmand Priory scholar based this necklace on ancient astrological charts found on jotun megaliths.</c>

name: Petrified Skull Juju
description: <c=@flavor>An ancient relic of the mystic beings of Echovald Forest.</c>

name: Nornbear's Remembrance
description: <c=@flavor>Once a painful reminder to Jora of her brother's curse.</c>

name: Archaic Grawl Necklace
description: <c=@flavor>From a time before the grawl had a spoken language.</c>

name: The Southsun Rose
description: <c=@flavor>The largest pink diamond in all of Tyria.</c>

name: Charisma
description: <c=@flavor>The locket contains a picture of Kolijn Johansson, Trade Administrator of Hoelbrak.</c>

name: Third-Place Medal
description: <c=@flavor>Congratulations from the Divinity's Reach Fancy Cat Association! Everyone is fancy in their own way.</c>

name: Prayer to Otter
description: <c=@flavor>Otter is a fickle spirit, but when she does grant a boon, it is a powerful gift indeed.</c>

name: The Queen's Necklace
description: <c=@flavor>Commissioned for Queen Jennah by a council member, but found too ornate for her tastes.</c>

name: Luxon Pendant
description: <c=@flavor>Smuggled out of Cantha long ago, a relic of the Serpent Clan.<c>

name: The Beetlestone Diamond
description: <c=@flavor>Mined from the Onyx Fields of Southsun Cove for the pleasure of Lord Beetlestone.</c>

name: Protomatter Chain
description: <c=@flavor>Some strange, ethereal material from the Mists has solidified into this odd necklace.</c>

name: Guild Commendation
description: Earned for completing guild missions. Can be traded to Tyrian Explorer Olread in Lion's Arch for rewards.

name: Guild Banquet
description: Spawns a banquet table, keg and various other party items which players can eat and drink from. Lasts 1 hour.

name: Guild Heroes Banner
description: Spawns a guild banner that will give +15% karma, +15% magic find, +15% experience from kills, +15% gold from kills, +15% increased movement speed, and +15% gathering chance to any ally that touches it for 30 minutes. Does not stack with other banner boosts.

name: Guild Gathering and Swiftness Banner
description: Spawns a guild banner that will give +15% gathering chance and 10% movement speed boost for 30 minutes to any ally who touches it. Does not stack with other gathering or speed banners.

name: Guild Gold and Magic Find Banner
description: Spawns a guild banner that will give +10% boost to gold from kills and +15% boost to magic find for 30 minutes to any ally who touches it. Does not stack with other gold or magic find banners.

name: Guild Gold from Kills Banner
description: Spawns a guild banner that will give +5% boost to gold earned from monster kills for 30 minutes to any ally who touches it. Does not stack with other gold banners.

name: Guild Karma and Experience Banner
description: Spawns a guild banner that will give +10% karma and +10% experience from kills boost for 30 minutes to any ally who touches it. Does not stack with other karma or experience banners.

name: Endless Guild Banner Tonic
description: Transform into your guild's banner for 15 minutes or until hit. You cannot move while transformed.

name: Refugee's Goblet

name: Refugee's Wooden Soldier

name: Letter from Eir
description:
"Solvi will be sorely missed, but he died a hero's death free of corruption. We have you to thank for that."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

name: Letter from Caithe
description:
"Let the loss of Ysvelta be a constant reminder of why we must stay strong against the Nightmare."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

name: Letter from Caithe
description:
"Bercilak was a powerful foe, and you bested him in fair combat. Be proud of yourself."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

name: Letter from Eir
description:
"With Korag gone, his remaining tribe may finally know peace. Take pride in their new beginning, Slayer."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

name: Letter from Eir
description:
"If not for you, there's no telling what Vidkun would have done to Minotaur. You saved a Spirit of the Wild—no small task."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

name: Letter from Logan
description:
"Even while acting as bait for Two-Blade Pete, you showed great courage. The Seraph, and I personally, owe you for your service."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

name: Letter from Logan
description:
"We never would have discovered the depths of Zamon's treachery without you. You've made me, the Seraph, and Kryta very proud."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

name: Letter from Logan
description:
"It's a great shame that Serentine's betrayal went unnoticed for so long. You've restored the reputation of the Seraph, and for that I'm sincerely grateful."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

name: Letter from Rytlock
description:
"As both man and ghost, Warmaster Lebofski's sent more than a few charr to the grave. And you stood up to him. Seems I was right about you."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

name: Letter from Rytlock
description:
"To keep cool while things heat up is a rare quality. You're a true testament to the Blood Legion."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

name: Letter from Rytlock
description:
"Today you showed me cunning can cut deeper than a knife. Trybulus had us outnumbered, but we persevered. Good work."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

name: Letter from Zojja
description:
"After your riveting success today, you deserve applause. Don't let Teyo's deeds sully what you've accomplished."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

name: Letter from Zojja
description:
"Gadd's lab was quite the fortuitous discovery. There were...unforeseen side effects, but you handled yourself brilliantly."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

name: Letter from Zojja
description:
"Astounding work! Kazz and Doxa couldn't be happier. Thanks to you, we've made amazing breakthroughs in metalurmagical bioessence divergences."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

name: Letter from Caithe
description:
"We'd have lost much had the stag died. Today was a triumph for nature, thanks to you."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

name: Mysterious Seedling
description: <c=@flavor>This young carnivorous plant has a wild streak to it. A meal of purified Sacred Plant Food should help it grow to be more obedient.<c>

name: Mysterious Seed
description: <c=@flavor>Plant in a Ley Line Infused Clay Pot to germinate.<c>

name: Pet Seed
description: <c=@flavor>The next generation of cultivated seed produced by your own hand. To cultivate this new specimen to be even better than the last, plant it in a Mists Infused Clay Pot to germinate.</c>

name: Mysterious Sprout
description: <c=@flavor>This young carnivorous plant could use something with a bit more kick to keep it growing. Some Phantasmally Infused Plant Food should do the trick.<c>

name: Ley Line Infused Clay Pot
description:
Double-click to plant a Mysterious Seed in this pot.

<c=@flavor>Everything needed to germinate a very special seed is in this pot now.<c>

name: Clay Pot
description: <c=@flavor>Missing just a few things needed to germinate a seed.<c>

name: Polarized Ley Line Infused Stone
description:
Combine in the Mystic Forge with a Clay Pot, Bloodstone Dust, and Foxfire Clusters to create a Ley Line Infused Clay Pot.

<c=@flavor>It's very difficult to focus your eyes on this stone. The space around it is rich with magical energy.<c>

name: Ley Line Infused Stone
description:
The polarity of this stone is locked in a stable matrix. A Ley Line disrupting device could unlock its potential forces.
Double-click to show.

name: Package of Sacred Plant Food
description:
Double-click to feed to a Mysterious Seedling.

<c=@flavor>Purified with Sacred Glacial Water to keep a wild plant well behaved while it matures.<c>

name: Plate of Meaty Plant Food
description: <c=@flavor>This mash of meaty, semi-toxic ingredients needs just a few more things to be the kind of food needed to calm a wild carnivorous plant.<c>

name: Vial of Sacred Glacial Water
description:
This water is warm and murky. It could be purified, but only at its source.
Double-click to show.

name: Purified Vial of Sacred Glacial Water
description:
Combine in the Mystic Forge with Meaty Plant Food, Bloodstone Dust, and Thick Leather Sections to create a Package of Sacred Plant Food.

<c=@flavor>This cool, clear mineral water from a sacred glacier could purify and nourish a magically growing plant.<c>

name: Package of Phantasmally Infused Plant Food
description:
Double-click to feed to a Mysterious Sprout.

<c=@flavor>This spicy snack has been infused with the essence of a phantasm and magically prepared for the connoisseur of carnivorous plants.<c>

name: Weirded Phantasmal Residue
description:
Combine in the Mystic Forge with Piquant Plant Food, Bloodstone Dust, and Thick Leather Sections to create a Package of Phantasmally Infused Plant Food.

<c=@flavor>A sticky pile of residue left behind by a powerful spirit.<c>

name: Pile of Phantasmal Residue
description:
This residue lies dormant. It could be imbued at a strong phantasmal energy source.
Double-click to show.

name: Plate of Piquant Plant Food
description: <c=@flavor>Just a couple ingredients shy of having the kind of kick an especially persnickety carnivorous plant would enjoy.<c>

name: Mysterious Vine
description: <c=@flavor>This vine, while appearing to be touched by Mordremoth, has been grown from seed under the good influence of a hero of Tyria.<c>

name: Recipe: Grow Lamp

name: Cultivated Sprout
description: <c=@flavor>This young carnivorous plant seems restless. Feed it something soothing, like Oasis Soaked Plant Food to calm it down.</c>

name: Cultivated Seedling
description: <c=@flavor>This young carnivorous plant looks hungry for something particularly magical. Some Ley Line Dusted Plant Food should satisfy its cravings.</c>

name: Cultivated Seed
description: <c=@flavor>The first seed cultivated and produced by your own hand. To cultivate this new specimen to be even better than the last, plant in a Chaos Infused Clay Pot to germinate.</c>

name: Cultivated Vine
description: <c=@flavor>This vine that you cultivated from seed, seems to almost like you. Is it possible that it is loyal to you as a child is to a parent?</c>

name: Resonating Chaos Orb
description:
Combine in the Mystic Forge with a Clay Pot, Bloodstone Dust, and Foxfire Clusters to create a Chaos Infused Clay Pot.

<c=@flavor>This orb is clearly very powerful. It buzzes and warbles as if it can't contain its mirth.</c>

name: Chaos Infused Clay Pot
description:
Double-click to plant a Cultivated Seed in this pot.

<c=@flavor>A pot so infused with energy, it's sure to germinate a more powerful seedling.</c>

name: Chaos Orb
description:
A humming emanates from this orb. It could be amplified with an additional source of Chaotic Radiation.
Double-click to show.

name: Pile of Crackling Ley Line Dust
description:
Combine in the Mystic Forge with Meaty Plant Food, Bloodstone Dust, and Thick Leather Sections to create a Package of Ley Line Dusted Plant Food.

<c=@flavor>This dust crackles and pops with magical energy.</c>

name: Package of Ley Line Dusted Plant Food
description:
Double-click to feed to a Cultivated Seedling.

<c=@flavor>Dusted with Ley Line power to nourish a growing magical carnivorous plant.</c>

name: Pile of Ley Line Dust
description:
An inert pile of dust from a ley line. A jolt of energy from a specialized asuran lab will energize it.
Double-click to show.

name: Package of Oasis Soaked Plant Food
description:
Double-click to feed to a Cultivated Sprout.

<c=@flavor>Soaked in the clean, cool waters from a Maguuma oasis.</c>

name: Empty Vial
description: Can be filled with Mending Oasis Water by stepping into the oasis.

name: Vial of Mending Oasis Water
description:
Combine in the Mystic Forge with Piquant Plant Food, Bloodstone Dust, and Thick Leather Sections to create a Package of Oasis Soaked Plant Food.

<c=@flavor>The waters of the Maguuma Jungle are famous for having inherent healing powers.</c>

name: Enormous Foxfire Cluster
description:
This powerful cluster of foxfire still needs a catalyst to fully unlock its growth potential.
Double-click to show.

name: Grow Lamp
description: <c=@flavor>Just needs a little extra something to attune this lamp for maximum growth potential.</c>

name: Germinated Foxfire Cluster
description:
Combine in the Mystic Forge with a Grow Lamp, Bloodstone Bricks, and exotic Essence of Luck to create an Attuned Grow Lamp.

<c=@flavor>A large and potent cluster of Foxfire.</c>

name: Attuned Grow Lamp
description:
Double-click to shine on a Cultivated Shoot.

<c=@flavor>With a hefty helping of luck, this lamp should get the most stubborn of plants to grow toward its light.</c>

name: Recipe: Heat Stone
description: Double-click to learn the recipe for a Heat Stone.

name: Mawdrey II
description: Double-click to feed 50 Piles of Bloodstone Dust in exchange for a gift. Mawdrey II will become full if fed too much dust in a day.

name: Pet Sprout
description: <c=@flavor>This young carnivorous plant could use something with a bit more kick to keep it growing. Some Rhand Blessed Plant Food should do the trick.</c>

name: Gift from Mawdrey II
description: Double-click to open Mawdrey II's gift.

name: Mawdrey (Infused)
description: <c=@flavor>After spending so much time cultivating this powerful vine through the generations, it's hard to not feel an attachment to it. Your beloved pet almost cuddles you in its tendrils. Clearly it feels a similar attachment.</c>

name: Pet Seedling
description: <c=@flavor>This young carnivorous plant looks hungry for something particularly magical. Some Elementally Charged Plant Food should satisfy its cravings.</c>

name: Mawdrey
description: <c=@flavor>After spending so much time cultivating this powerful vine through the generations, it's hard to not feel an attachment to it. Your beloved pet almost cuddles you in its tendrils. Clearly it feels a similar attachment.</c>

name: Pet Shoot
description: <c=@flavor>Growth seems to be slowing again. You need an even bigger kick of sun to speed back up the growth process. Something like a Powerful Grow Lamp would be perfect.</c>

name: Pet Plantling
description: <c=@flavor>Your dear plantling has grown quite a bit, but it seems to ache for the warmth of the Maguuma Jungle. Something to warm it thoroughly, like a Destroyer Heated Stone, should keep it toasty.</c>

name: Mists Stone
description:
Combine in the Mystic Forge with a Clay Pot, Bloodstone Dust, and Foxfire Clusters to create a Mists Infused Clay Pot.

<c=@flavor>A stone taken from the Mists, steeped in its power.</c>

name: Mists Infused Clay Pot
description:
Double-click to plant your Pet Seed in this pot.

<c=@flavor>A pot infused with the energy of the Mists.</c>

name: Pile of Elemental Essence
description:
Combine in the Mystic Forge with Meaty Plant Food, Bloodstone Dust, and Thick Leather Sections to create a Package of Elementally Charged Plant Food.

<c=@flavor>A crackling pile of elementally charged essence.</c>

name: Package of Elementally Charged Plant Food
description:
Double-click to feed to your Pet Seedling.

<c=@flavor>Watch your fingers—this food occasionally gives you a bit of a jolt.</c>

name: Water of Rhand
description:
Combine in the Mystic Forge with Piquant Plant Food, Bloodstone Dust, and Thick Leather Sections to create a Package of Rhand Blessed Plant Food.

<c=@flavor>The Font of Rhand is known to be a very magical place.</c>

name: Package of Rhand Blessed Plant Food
description:
Double-click to feed to your Pet Sprout.

<c=@flavor>Soaked in water from the Font of Rhand.</c>

name: Box of Captured Light
description:
Combine in the Mystic Forge with a Grow Lamp, Bloodstone Bricks, and exotic Essence of Luck to create a Powerful Grow Lamp.

<c=@flavor>Every crack in its container glows from the light within.</c>

name: Powerful Grow Lamp
description:
Double-click to shine on your Pet Shoot.

<c=@flavor>Armed with a light that shone in the dark, this lamp is very powerful.</c>

name: Heat Stone
description: <c=@flavor>A simple heat stone isn't quite enough to channel the sweltering temperatures of the deep Maguuma Jungle.</c>

name: Destroyer Heated Stone
description:
Double-click to warm your Pet Plantling.

<c=@flavor>Special care should be taken with this hot stone if you don't want to get burned.</c>

name: Heart of the Destroyer
description:
Combine in the Mystic Forge with a Heat Stone, Bloodstone Bricks, and a +5 Agony Infusion to create a Destroyer Heated Stone.

<c=@flavor>A steaming hot stone from the core of a powerful Destroyer.</c>

description:
The New Horizons Supply Drop
Use this to sign your account up for weekly New Horizons Supply Drops. Receive the first drop immediately and three more between now and September 17.

First Drop:
New Horizons Mount Select License, a choice of one Desert Racer, Distant Lands, Istani Isles, or Exotic Breeds mount select license or a New Horizons Mount Adoption License, 2 Knife Tail Gang Hunting Bonds, and an Endless Ocean Weapon Select Box.
Second Drop:
Black Lion Outfit Voucher, Victorious Dye Kit, 5 Black Lion Statuettes, a Mini Green Raptor Hatchling, Mini Yellow Jackal Pup, Mini Red Griffon Hatchling, Mini Brown Springer Kit, Mini Blue Skimmer Pup, and Mini Gray Skyscale Hatchling.
Third Drop:
2 Black Lion Miniature Claim Tickets, a Black Lion Backpack and Glider Voucher, Communal Boost Bonfire, 2 Heroic Boosters, and 2 Guaranteed Wardrobe Unlocks.
Fourth Drop:
1 Black Lion Weapon Ticket, 1 Golden Black Lion Chest Key, and 5 Black Lion Chest Keys.

name: 8th Anniversary Supply Drop Requisition
description:
The 8th Anniversary Supply Drop
Use this to sign your account up for weekly 8th Anniversary Supply Drops. Receive the first drop immediately and three more between now and September 15.

First Drop:
5 Black Lion Chest Keys, a Golden Black Lion Chest Key, 2 Guaranteed Wardrobe Unlocks, and a Lorekeeper Weapon Select Box.
Second Drop:
A Bizarre Beasts Mount Select License, a choice of one Exotic Breeds, Mistborn, Curious Creatures, or New Horizons Mount Select License or a Bizarre Beasts Mount Adoption License, and a Black Lion Outfit Voucher.
Third Drop:
A Black Lion Dye Canister Package, a Black Lion Backpack and Glider Voucher, and a Black Lion Weapons Voucher.
Fourth Drop:
5 Black Lion Statuettes, a Mythic Weapon Choice, 2 Black Lion Miniature Claim Tickets, and a Black Lion Booster Box.
